description: This file defines the SyntaxErrorException class used within the JmesPath namespace to represent syntax errors encountered during parsing of JmesPath expressions. It extends the built-in InvalidArgumentException and customizes the error message to include specific context such as position and token details.

classes.name: SyntaxErrorException
classes.description: Custom exception class to handle syntax errors in JmesPath parsing, providing contextual error messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a SyntaxErrorException with a detailed message including position, expression, and token details.

methods.name: createTokenMessage
methods.description: Helper method to format an error message indicating expected tokens and the actual token encountered.
